name: Vannifar
description: Vannifar is the Prime Speaker and guildmaster of the Simic Combine.

summary.text: Vannifar is the Prime Speaker and guildmaster of the Simic Combine.

bio.text: Vannifar led the Simic Combine as guildmaster, with Vorel leading in the field, and she was among the guild representatives in the Operation Desperation ritual that Nissa led.

bio.text: She unseated Zegana's predecessor, which left the two on poor terms, though they were rivals who were like sisters.

timeline.summary: Under Prime Speaker Vannifar the Simic mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers.
timeline.quote: the Simic started to mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers

citation.text: "Mutant", section "Simic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Golgari incursions threaten Zonot Four, Vannifar replaces Zegana as Prime Speaker and begins the Guardian Project.
timeline.quote: Zegana was replaced as Prime Speaker by Vannifar

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar's faction loses influence when the Living Guildpact emerges, and she retreats to Zonot Three to continue experimentation.
timeline.quote: Vannifar herself retreated to Zonot Three to continue what she still saw as a pressing matter of guild survival.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana summons Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.
timeline.quote: Zegana had to summon Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar makes Zegana's leadership the subject of open debate and is voted the new Prime Speaker.
timeline.quote: A vote was called, and Vannifar was made the new Prime Speaker .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The entire Simic Combine aligns with the adaptationists under Vannifar.
timeline.quote: Under Vannifar's leadership, the entirety of the Simic Combine has aligned with the adaptationists .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar authorizes the Guardian Project at Navika, creating humanoid hybrid soldiers; Roalesk is the first success.
timeline.quote: The first successful result of the Guardian Project was Roalesk .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "The Guardian Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark, Vorel represents Vannifar at the guild meeting and tells Ral she had prepared for war long before Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vorel told Ral Zarek that Vannifar was a fighter and had been preparing for war long before Bolas was known to be a threat.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar represents the guild at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Vannifar served as the representative for the guild at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Zegana tries to regain Prime Speaker and is then brutally murdered; Vannifar seeks other guilds' aid and keeps her position.
timeline.quote: after Zegana was brutally murdered

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana mistakes Kellan for the detective Proft.
timeline.quote: Are you quite sure you're not that detective Proft everyone's been talking about?

timeline.summary: Teysa informs Vannifar of Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: it is with the deepest of regrets that I inform you that Zegana of the Simic Combine has been killed.

timeline.quote: Vannifar won't allow this to go unanswered.

timeline.quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

timeline.quote: Zegana was fascinated by the Phyrexian oil.

timeline.summary: Vannifar reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.
timeline.quote: She was seeking a cure for phyresis, the spreading taint of Phyrexia

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion many Simic become Phyrexianized; Vannifar and Zegana settle their grievances and Zegana researches a cure.
timeline.quote: Vannifar and Zegana settled their old grievances

timeline.summary: Vannifar is present at Karlov Manor when Zegana is assassinated and avoids questioning.
timeline.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated, and avoided questioning when the Azorius began investigating.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Vannifar, who is freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat Oba.
timeline.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Vannifar was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.
